meta.name: Bandish Bandits
meta.description:
A classical singer Radhe falls in love with pop singer Tamanna and embarks on a path that forces him to compromise his classical roots. With time, both the singers try to get out of their comfort zone while  trying to protect their stardom. This series tests their resolve for their passion and love.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 8/8

videos.title: Blue Bandit
videos.overview: Radhe, a music prodigy in the classical tradition, meets Tamanna, a viral YouTube pop sensation, who comes from a world diametrically opposed to his.

videos.title: Shuddhikaran
videos.overview: Radhe's interaction with Tamanna jeopardises his musical dream, so that he has to prove himself to his mentor and grandfather, Panditji.

videos.title: Roleplay
videos.overview: Radhe begins to sing with Tamanna for financial reasons, but love and attraction grow between the young couple as they work on their first song together.

videos.title: Phas Gaye
videos.overview: Personal and musical stress starts to show as Radhe feverishly juggles the simultaneous and clashing demands of Tamanna and Panditji.

videos.title: Masked Man
videos.overview: Radhe gets a shocking glimpse into the inner life of his grandfather, even as he struggles to navigate a tense music video shoot with Tamanna.

videos.title: A Star is Born
videos.overview: Radhe starts training under Panditji to sing against his estranged uncle Digvijay, while his first song with Tamanna releases and is an instant hit.

videos.title: #CoupleGoals
videos.overview: Radhe takes on new gigs to help repay his father's loan, which puts a strain on his increasingly fraught relationships with both Tamanna and Panditji.

videos.title: Bandish Bandits
videos.overview: Radhe teaches Tamanna to sing live for a last shot at her dream of collaborating with an international pop star, while his own training with Panditji receives an enormous setback.

videos.title: A Separation
videos.overview: Radhe is utterly broken and on the verge of giving up as he loses both Tamanna and Panditji, but his soft-spoken mother rises to save the day.

videos.title: Sangeet Samrat
videos.overview: Joy, sorrow and adrenaline charge through the final episode as Radhe and Digvijay sing off against each other in a fierce battle for the Rathod family's musical future.

videos.title: Panditji
videos.overview: The Rathods hold a heartfelt memorial for Panditji. Arghya offers Radhe a spot in Rage and Raga, but he declines. Scandalous details tarnish Panditji's legacy, affecting Radhe's career. Burdened, Radhe joins Rage and Raga for redemption. In Himachal Pradesh, Tamanna joins a music school, and leads her band for the India Band Championship under Nandini's mentorship, despite initial challenges.

videos.title: Holding On
videos.overview: Radhe heads to Mumbai to revive his Gharaana, joining Rage and Raga despite warnings and clashes with Mahi to earn his place. In Jodhpur, Rajendra arranges a poorly received gig for Mohini, witnessed by Digvijay. Radhe's debut sours when Mahi twists Panditji’s raag into a jingle. Tamanna unites her band with a spontaneous performance but faces misunderstandings with Radhe, finding solace in Ayaan.

videos.title: The Voyager
videos.overview: Nandini sidelines Tamanna from IBC prep and makes her do notations. She later improves vocally after understanding Nandini’s intent. In Jodhpur, Mohini and Digvijay rekindle their friendship, while Rajendra succumbs to jealousy. Back in Mumbai, Radhe, frustrated with Mahi mocking Panditji’s work, decides to form a new band for the India Band Championship despite family opposition.

videos.title: Bebaqiyaan
videos.overview: Tamanna invites her band to her Mom's wedding, where Ayan meets his idol, Imroz Dehelvi, and secures his help with their IBC song. Radhe convinces Devendra to join the family band. Arghya struggles to find an artist fitting the Rathod Gharana style. Mohini and Digvijay's collaboration leads to a national tour, and Radhe's audition ends in rejection for lack of originality, crushing his IBC dreams.

videos.title: Nirmohiya
videos.overview: At the IBC audition, Tamanna revitalizes her band's performance, but tensions rise as Saumya accuses her of undermining her. Meanwhile, Tamanna exposes plagiarism by another band, prompting Arghya to secure a second chance for Radhe's band. At the competition, Radhe's band earns a spot alongside Jwalamukhi. Arghya reveals Tamanna's role in disqualifying the previous band, and Radhe thanks her.

videos.title: Hitchki
videos.overview: After qualifying for IBC, Radhe’s band gets paired with Rock and Mahi as their mentor for a round. Radhe reconciles with Mahi and accepts his guidance, leading to a successful performance. Tamanna’s secret relationship with Ayaan causes tension. Radhe sees Ayaan kiss Tamanna, leading to a confrontation where Radhe and Tamanna express their unresolved feelings in a passionate embrace.

videos.title: Bandish Bandits
videos.overview: Radhe’s band picks Royalty free for versus round, and Tamanna’s band chooses a challenging song. The Rathods struggle with pop music, but they adapt a Panditji composition to fit the song’s raga. On stage, Tamanna excels initially but falters with high notes, allowing Radhe to win. Tamanna left the competition. The Rathods are devastated when Digvijay copyrights Panditji’s composition.

videos.title: Qarar
videos.overview: Ayaan reads Tamanna's letter about leaving, deciding the band will perform without her. The Rathods seek help from Bhairav Singh, Panditji's friend for their finale. Tamanna, guided by Nandini, returns with a new composition, which the band uses. Radhe and Mohini reveal Panditji's truth to a moved Digvijay. Royalty Free wins the finale. Radhe and Tamanna share a final dance before parting.
